theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Swings Don't Mean Real Losses
body: Volatility is normal. Panic selling during downturns often locks in losses. Patient investors ride cycles.
caption: Markets fluctuate naturally over time. Staying invested through cycles has historically benefited long-term wealth builders. Emotional decisions often hurt returns. #BehaviouralFinance #MarketVolatility #InvestmentDiscipline #StayInvested #LongTermWealth
